item.title: EU urged to combat violations of religious freedom in South Asia
item.description: Citing a dramatic escalation of targeted attacks against Christians and other minorities in their countries, human rights advocates from South Asia called for stronger EU engagement on freedom of religion or belief at a conference in Brussels on December 4.

item.title: Nigerian authorities secure release of 100 kidnapped Catholic school children
item.description: The fate of more than 160 other students and staff members abducted in the same attack remains unknown.

item.title: Hundreds of churches in Germany being targeted with vandalism and theft
item.description: The cost of the damage to both churches and chapels runs into hundreds of thousands of euros.

item.title: MP calls for emergency meeting to end case against suspended Christian nurse
item.description: Shadow equalities minister, Claire Coutinho MP, has called for an end to the case against Christian nurse Jennifer Melle, who is facing disciplinary proceedings for misgendering a convicted paedophile.

item.title: Winchester Cathedral announces its next dean
item.description: The Rev Canon Chris Palmer, currently serving as Canon Treasurer at Exeter Cathedral, has been appointed the next Dean of Winchester, Downing Street has announced.

item.title: Pastor shot dead outside home months after surviving earlier attack
item.description: Christian communities in Pakistan are grappling with shock and grief after the killing of the Rev Kamran Salamat, a Presbyterian pastor who was gunned down outside his home in Gujranwala on 5 December.

item.title: 'See No Evil' documentary to shine a light on John Smyth abuse
item.description: The documentary will air on Channel 4.

item.title: Labour's taxes threaten Christian schools, churches and vicarages
item.description: The Bishop of Manchester has called upon the government to exempt vicars from a new mansion tax.

item.title: Teacher fired after telling Muslim pupil Britain is a Christian country
item.description: The teacher was apparently sanctioned despite saying things that were "incontestably true".

item.title: Two slain in church shooting in southeast Nigeria
item.description: Some of kidnapped children in Niger state are released.
